line: Hold the door for the next five people.
paragraph: A team surveying tortoises on the Aldabra atoll in the Seychelles counted roughly 180,000 giant tortoises roaming free. That is the highest number ever recorded for the species. The tortoises were once endangered. Now they thrive. It is good to learn that patience and care can repair what seemed broken. Maybe holding a door today is a lighter thing, but it is a small gravity that lets the next person arrive easier.
